variants.headline: Looking back: household savings committed to a company plan
variants.sub: Household savings have been put into a business plan by {founder}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The settler {founder} had committed household savings to a plan for {business}.

The gazette records the plan and the commitment of household savings. Planning a company and beginning its operations are distinct stages. The public account should preserve that distinction while recognising that a proposal can already represent a material commitment by the person seeking to establish it.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We judge {target} critically. Household initiative deserves responsible stewardship of the conditions around it, not a convenient celebration of ambition that leaves the practical burden of a plan outside political scrutiny.
